Definition: Nepheg, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Nepheg = "sprout"; 1) one of sons of Izhar and grandson of Kohath of the tribe of Levi in the time of the exodus; 2) one of the sons of David born to him at Jerusalem
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
